title: Show Outline
manageHint: Right-click · Ctrl/Cmd-click to select for moving
singleDeleteOnly: Select one item before deleting; multi-selection is for moving.
refreshBeforeMove: Refresh the outline before moving multiple items.
undoTip: Undo the last Show Outline change (Ctrl/Cmd+Z)
redoTip: Redo the last Show Outline change (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z or Ctrl/Cmd+Y)
busy: A Show Outline operation is already in progress.
inlineHint: Enter to save · Escape to cancel
copyHint: Creates independent scenes with new IDs, without generated results or history.
deleteGroupConfirm: Delete “{name}”? Only empty shows and acts can be deleted.
deletedRefreshFailed: The hierarchy was deleted, but the outline could not be refreshed: {error}
refresh: Refresh shows and scenes from disk
resize: Resize Show Outline and Results panes
rootRules: Enabled roots override the corresponding Generate-node settings. When off, those settings are inherited. Local copies are made on the computer running Libretto.
comfyRootOverrides: The show’s ComfyUI output root overrides this prefix.
localRootOverrides: The show’s local copy root overrides this folder.
workflowRootOutput: The show root is prepended to each imported workflow output prefix.
workflowOutput: Keep the imported workflow's output prefix unless the Generate node overrides it.
emptyPreview: Add a scene to preview its output path.
outputRules: Without a show ComfyUI root, explicit Generate-node prefixes take precedence over the layout. The workflow adds its image counter and extension.
outputNumbering: Numbers follow outline order. Show / Scene numbers span the show; Show / Act / Scene resets scene numbers within each act and omits the act folder for direct scenes. Paths use original show, act and scene names, not translations.
futureOutputs: Applies to future generations only. Existing images are not moved. Renaming or reordering changes future paths.
outputInherited: Inherited from show “{name}”: {layout}. Leave the prefix empty to use it.
outputOverride: This prefix overrides show “{name}” output layout: {layout}.
